en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural village in a hilly, forested area. Traditional multi‑storey houses with gabled roofs sit in a valley below dense conifer woods. A wide cleared strip runs up through the forested hillside in the background. The foreground shows fields, fences, small outbuildings and a road lined with trees and utility poles. Printed German text appears along the bottom border of the image.
